chose: the transition log is two insert-only tables in Groups' transitions module: userGroupDepartures, a row per membership the copy drops with the instant it was kept from (the membership's creation) and the instant it was dropped, and groupCountingChanges, a row per instant a group starts or stops counting; a current membership's join instant is its row's creation, so joins need no row; reconcile replays both from the member's latest history entry (#394)
over: a row per join and per departure (4 writes per swapped member, a 4,000 cap)
soft-deleting memberships with a left-at patch (not insert-only, and every copy reader would filter departed rows)
one log row per members list holding every user (a group's log rows would be read whole on every page)
because: the copy deletes memberships without a trace (#319 R4 #1, #321 finding 1, #323 R1 #1); departures and counting changes are the only facts it loses, and replaying them dates each change exactly whatever the group's later changes
binding: none: this session owns no active work order

chose: reconcile replays the transition log from the member's latest history entry (or their directory row's creation) and applies one rule at every instant: keep the primary group while it counts for them, else the smallest they count in, else none; what the log doesn't explain changes at the directory's instant or now
over: keeping the instant heuristics (departedAt, countsSince, latestChangeOf, the page's copy cause) beside the log
because: the replay subsumes every case those heuristics guessed (fallback instants, a new group arriving later, defaults no earlier than a group counting again), and every existing groups test passes unchanged against it; the cause the copy carried into pages is dropped (#394)
binding: none: this session owns no active work order

chose: a user group keeps at most 5,000 members (was 7,500, d-7defc3fe)
over: keeping 7,500 and moving the departures of a large swap into a scheduled continuation
because: logging each dropped membership adds a write per removal: a disjoint swap at the cap is 2N + N writes, so 5,000 keeps it at 15,001 under Convex's 16,000; a continuation would leave stale memberships readable between mutations and race a newer members list
binding: none: this session owns no active work order
